title: Trisomy 8 alters chromatin conformations and activates Y chromosome genes in stem cells to drive a pre-leukemic state
task: Elucidate mechanisms of trisomy 8 in myelodysplastic syndrome pathogenesis
key_results: Trisomy 8 alters chromatin conformations and activates Y chromosome genes (Uty/Kdm6c); Uty demethylates H3K27me3 and activates leukemogenic genes; RUNX1 deletion attenuates inflammatory gene expression
comments: Elegant discovery of epigenetic modifier activation via chromosome imbalance; Uty as therapeutic target may be challenging given Y-chromosome restriction, but PRC2-target reactivation offers alternative approach.

model_io.model: Trisomy 8 mouse model with human chromosome 8 transfer and human trisomy 8 leukemic cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trisomy 8 activates Y chromosome genes (Uty) to drive MDS pathogenesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Uty facilitates PRC2-target and Runx1-target activation

hypotheses.hypothesis: RUNX1 deletion mitigates trisomy 8 HSC dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduces inflammatory gene expression and restores self-renewal

title: EBNA1BP2 (EBP2) promotes the progression of hepatocellular carcinoma through upregulating the expression of MCM8 and HMGB1
task: Determine EBP2 role in hepatocellular carcinoma progression
key_results: EBP2 overexpression correlates with advanced HCC staging; EBP2 knockdown reduces proliferation and migration while enhancing apoptosis; MCM8 overexpression rescues proliferation effects
comments: Dual regulatory axes (EBP2-CENPA-MCM8 and EBP2-CENPA/YY1-HMGB1) suggest mechanistic redundancy that may limit therapeutic targeting.

model_io.model: HCC cell lines and xenograft models

hypotheses.hypothesis: EBP2 promotes HCC progression via MCM8-mediated DNA repair
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MCM8 overexpression rescues EBP2 knockdown phenotype

hypotheses.hypothesis: EBP2 regulates HMGB1 through CENPA/YY1 complex
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pathway identified as parallel driver of HCC progression

title: Organelle contact sites in cancer cells
task: Review membrane contact sites in cancer cells and therapeutic implications
key_results: MCSs regulate lipid homeostasis, intracellular signaling, metabolism, and redox balance; disruption associated with cancer progression
comments: Largely a review article with limited new data; identifies MCS modulation as emerging therapeutic avenue but lacks concrete experimental validation in oncology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MCS disruption contributes to cancer progression
hypotheses.result: Literature evidence suggests association; mechanistic causality remains unclear

title: Therapeutic potential of BH3-mimetics and NK cell-mediated immunotherapy in T-ALL
task: Evaluate BH3-mimetic drugs and NK cell immunotherapy for T-ALL treatment
key_results: ETP-ALL sensitive to BCL-2 inhibition; heterogeneous BCL-XL sensitivity; AZD4320+AZD5991 combination synergistic; AZD4320+NK cells enhance killing
comments: BH3-profiling provides predictive insight into drug sensitivity; combination approach promising but heterogeneity suggests biomarker-driven patient stratification will be necessary.

model_io.model: T-ALL cell lines and PDX samples
outputs: NK cell-mediated killing at varying E:T ratios

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anti-apoptotic dependency correlates with BH3-mimetic sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BH3-profiling predicts heterogeneous responses

hypotheses.hypothesis: AZD4320 synergizes with NK cells to enhance T-ALL killing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; proposed as effective combination therapy

title: Repulsion from slow-diffusing nutrients improves microbial chemotaxis towards moving sources
task: Explain paradoxical repulsion behavior in bacterial chemotaxis toward moving nutrient sources
key_results: Combination of attraction to fast-diffusing and repulsion from slow-diffusing nutrients increases source interception up to 6-fold; E. coli exhibits differential strategy matching this pattern
comments: Elegant computational and experimental work revealing how counterintuitive signal integration improves chemotactic performance; suggests evolution optimized for dynamic rather than static gradients.

model_io.model: E. coli chemotaxis simulation and tracking assay

hypotheses.hypothesis: Repulsion from slow-diffusing nutrients improves chemotaxis to moving sources
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 6-fold increase in interception; robust to parameter variations

hypotheses.hypothesis: E. coli uses differential strategy with fast-nutrient attraction and slow-nutrient repulsion
hypotheses.result: Supported by existing data; explains previously paradoxical amino acid repulsion

title: Extracellular matrix: new insights into its role in female reproductive aging and potential therapeutic strategies
task: Review extracellular matrix remodeling in female reproductive aging and therapeutic strategies
key_results: Age-associated ECM changes (collagen cross-linking, elastin degradation) drive ovarian aging via Hippo signaling; decellularized scaffolds and engineered hydrogels restore function in preclinical models
comments: Comprehensive review identifying ECM as key aging hallmark; therapeutic approaches show promise but translation to clinical reproductive restoration remains preliminary.

model_io.model: Reproductive tissue in vitro and in vivo aging models

hypotheses.hypothesis: ECM aging drives reproductive dysfunction via Hippo signaling
hypotheses.result: Supported; mechanical activation mechanism identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: ECM-targeted interventions restore reproductive capacity
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated in preclinical models; clinical translation pending

title: Zebrafish gon4la mutants recapitulate human GON4L-related growth disorders and reveal novel metabolic organs abnormalities
task: Define Gon4la function in zebrafish growth and model GON4L-related growth disorders
key_results: All gon4la mutants show proportionate dwarfism with intestinal/pancreatic abnormalities; YY1AP1-like region deletion causes reduced igf1a expression and elevated growth hormone pathway activity
comments: Domain-specific mutants reveal functional specialization; phenotype closely recapitulates human LTMS, providing tractable model for rare variant analysis.

inputs: Gon4la truncations affecting YY1AP1-like region, PAH, and SANT domains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gon4la domains contribute differentially to systemic growth and organ homeostasis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; YY1AP1-like region required for endocrine homeostasis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gon4la mutants model human GON4L-related developmental disorders
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; phenotype recapitulates LTMS features

title: Colorectal cancer cells respond differentially to autophagy induced by tyrosine kinase inhibitors
task: Determine role of autophagy in colorectal cancer cell response to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
key_results: Nintedanib induces autophagy; autophagy inhibition reduces Nintedanib cytotoxicity but not Regorafenib; opposing effects on Akt-mTOR (Nintedanib) vs. Erk (Regorafenib) pathways
comments: Differential dependence on autophagy between two structurally similar TKIs highlights context-dependent drug mechanisms; autophagic flux could serve as predictive biomarker for Nintedanib sensitivity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autophagy mediates Nintedanib cytotoxicity in CRC
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; autophagy inhibition reduces activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Opposing pathway effects explain differential autophagy dependence
hypotheses.result: Supported; Nintedanib inhibits mTOR (autophagy-permissive), Regorafenib activates it (autophagy-restrictive)

title: Gungnir codec enabling high error-tolerance and low-redundancy DNA storage through substantial computing power
task: Error correction for DNA storage using proof-of-work based codec
key_results: Complete binary data recovery from sequences with 20% erroneous bases; single-copy sequence sufficiency without high redundancy or coverage
comments: Proof-of-work approach is computationally expensive but pragmatically addresses the core tension between error resilience and storage overhead in DNA archiving.

model_io.model: Gungnir codec with hash signature verification

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hash-based error correction with biochemical constraints enables single-copy recovery from highly corrupted sequences
hypotheses.result: Achieved 20% error tolerance with complete data recovery

title: Telomere-to-Telomere gap-free genome assembly of the allotetraploid wild raspberry Rubus alceifolius Poir
task: Telomere-to-telomere gap-free genome assembly of allotetraploid wild raspberry
key_results: 462.05 Mb assembly anchored into 14 pseudochromosomes; 46,698 protein-coding genes; 12.44 Mb inversion structural variant on Chr2 subgenome A
comments: High-quality polyploid assembly addresses a critical genomic resource gap, though functional significance of the large inversion remains to be investigated.

model_io.model: Multi-technology genome assembly and annotation pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-quality genome assembly enables identification of adaptive evolution mechanisms and breeding targets in polyploid Rubus
hypotheses.result: Complete telomere-to-telomere assembly with 28 telomeric regions and comprehensive gene annotation recovered

title: Transformer augmented hybrid deep learning for explainable multi class pest classification
task: Multi-class pest classification using CNN-Transformer hybrid architectures
key_results: Hybrid EfficientNetV2-S + Transformer achieved 88.00% validation accuracy, 0.849 macro-F1 on 19 pest species
comments: Attention-augmented hybrids consistently outperform standalone CNNs, but the 88% accuracy may be insufficient for autonomous field deployment without human verification.

model_io.model: Hybrid CNN-Transformer ensemble (EfficientNetV2-S + Transformer, ResNet50 + CBAM, EffNet-Transformer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures with attention mechanisms outperform standalone convolutional models
hypotheses.result: Hybrid EfficientNetV2-S + Transformer achieved highest performance (0.88 accuracy vs. <0.85 for standalone CNNs)

title: Computational identification of a marine derived dual inhibitor for type 2 diabetes mellitus using integrated in silico approaches
task: Computational discovery of dual PTP1B/DPP-4 inhibitor from marine compounds for T2DM
key_results: CID_5281663 (1,3,5-trihydroxyxanthone) from Lobophytum microlobulatum identified as dual inhibitor with docking affinities −8.7 and −9.0 kcal/mol; MM-GBSA binding free energies −5955.51 ± 54.24 and −8895.41 ± 202.85 kcal/mol
comments: Comprehensive in silico pipeline is sound, but experimental validation remains essential; the compound is novel but lacks prior bioactivity data.

model_io.model: Integrated drug discovery pipeline: filtering → docking → MD simulation → DFT analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Marine-derived compounds can serve as dual PTP1B/DPP-4 inhibitors addressing both insulin and incretin signaling defects
hypotheses.result: 1,3,5-trihydroxyxanthone demonstrated stable dual-target binding in 200 ns MD simulations with favorable thermodynamic metrics

title: A machine learning based framework for predictive school management using student and faculty analytics
task: Integrated machine learning framework for predictive school management and at-risk student identification
key_results: 99.6% and 97.5% predictive accuracy (5.6% and 6.3% improvement over baselines); 99.4% and 96.7% recall; <0.1% parental education bias gap after mitigation
comments: Multi-paradigm integration (LSTM/GRU/CNN/Transformers + XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost + GCNs) is comprehensive but complex; cross-institutional validation is absent, limiting generalizability claims.

model_io.model: Hybrid ensemble: deep learning (LSTM, GRU, CNN, Transformers) + gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) + GCNs with multitask/transfer/federated learning

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-paradigm AI integration combining temporal modeling, structured data inference, and relationship encoding yields superior at-risk student identification
hypotheses.result: Hybrid framework achieved 99.6% accuracy and 99.4% recall, outperforming TabTransformer (97.2%)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fairness mitigation strategies reduce demographic and socioeconomic bias in educational predictive models
hypotheses.result: Parental education gap reduced to 0.1% via reweighting and adversarial debiasing

title: An operational target trial emulation framework for causal inference using electronic health record data
task: Framework for causal inference from EHR data using target trial emulation
key_results: Operational framework distinguishing trial specification from EHR data realization; clarification of identifiability constraints
comments: Review paper providing methodological guidance rather than empirical results; critical for ensuring validity when RCTs are infeasible.

title: A neural-symbolic AI agent system for biomedical concept mapping
task: Biomedical concept mapping using neural-symbolic AI with language models
key_results: Recall@1: 63.3 (MedMentions), 60.0 (ST21pv), 67.9 (MCN); zero-shot abbreviation handling +24.8 points over baselines; 79.4% human approval of LLM expansions
comments: LLM-based rephrasing is elegant and interpretable, but the reliance on LLM quality introduces a dependency on external model stability and potential annotation drift.

model_io.model: Medical Concept Mapping (MCM): agentic workflow with LLM rephrasing and concept linking

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM-based rephrasing of ambiguous mentions improves concept linking accuracy, especially for long-tail and abbreviated concepts
hypotheses.result: MCM outperformed KrissBERT, SciSpaCy, USAGI; 24.8 point improvement on zero-shot abbreviations

title: Decipher-MR: a vision-language foundation model for 3D MRI representations
task: Foundation model for 3D MRI representation learning
key_results: 200,000 MRI series trained; consistent improvements in disease classification, demographic prediction, and anatomical localization
comments: The modular architecture with frozen encoder and lightweight task-specific decoders is practical, though absolute performance metrics for downstream tasks are not provided in the abstract.

model_io.model: Decipher-MR: vision-language foundation model with self-supervised learning and report guidance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of self-supervised vision learning with report-guided text supervision enables generalizable MRI representations
hypotheses.result: Outperformed existing foundation models and task-specific approaches across multiple evaluation tasks
